scheme_name: Internship Programme At Serious Fraud Investigation Office
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian national.
Applicant must be a student pursuing post‑graduation (e.g., MBA Finance, Law, Economics, Management, Computer Forensics) or a fresh graduate with a first‑class graduation degree.
Graduate applicants must have secured a first‑class degree in graduation.
If the applicant has a second‑class graduation degree, a minimum of 55% marks is required.
Interns must furnish a Declaration of Secrecy before the commencement of the internship.
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹7,000 per month and a certificate of internship upon satisfactory completion.
